environment.description: Same Flask application packaged as a container image and deployed behind an AWS Lambda function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has a resource-based policy that grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principals matching condition 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' equal to 'o-a1b2c3d4e5'. Unauthenticated HTTP requests to the function URL receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service itself before reaching application code. The function URL's CORS configuration allows only origins matching *.internal.corp.example.com. Additionally, the Lambda is in a VPC with a security group that only allows outbound to the ElastiCache Redis cluster on port 6379 within the same private subnet. There is no inbound internet path to the Redis instance. Note: the session_id parameter acceptance in the code remains unchanged.

config.deployment: AWS Lambda container image with function URL
config.vpc_config: private subnet, sg egress only to ElastiCache on 6379
config.redis: ElastiCache in private subnet, no public endpoint, AUTH token required
